content.title: First Financial (THFF) Net Profit Margin Surges to 30.2%, Reinforcing Value Narrative
content.summary: First Financial (THFF) is forecasting revenue growth at 5.1% per year, which notably trails the broader US market's 10.2% pace. EPS is set to inch up just 0.5% annually, well below the market’s 15.6%. The company’s net profit margin climbed to 30.2% from last year’s 22.9%. Over the past year, earnings growth reached 70.3%, outpacing the company’s five-year average and highlighting a significant rise in profitability in the most recent period.
